blockers.width: FPC width not published at a reachable source (repo stand-in: 16 mm at the 15-pin end, 11.5 mm at the 22-pin end, scene_extras 'UNVERIFIED'). Lower bound from the cited pitch and pin count, calc only: (15 - 1) x 1.0 = 14 mm and (22 - 1) x 0.5 = 10.5 mm between outer contact centres. The route is checked at 16 mm over its whole length (worst case). Settles it: caliper on the received cable (TO9), or adafruit.com / datasheets.raspberrypi.com allowed in this session.
blockers.thickness: FPC thickness not published at a reachable source (repo stand-in 0.3 mm). Settles it: caliper (TO9).
blockers.bend: No minimum bend radius or fold rule for this cable at a reachable source. Bends here are 3 mm and up; folds are flat 45 degree folds, not pressed to a crease. Settles it: TO9 test fit (fold over a 1 mm former, then check the camera image).
